name: AllSERP
description: We release AllSERP, a typed AOI and per-element behavioral enrichment of the AdSERP commercial-intent SERP corpus [4]. AdSERP ships 2,776 trials of full-page screenshots, captured SERP HTML, 150 Hz Gazepoint eye tracking, evtrack mouse telemetry, scroll, and pupil signals against real Google SERPs collected before AI Overviews -- but its bounding boxes cover only ad surfaces (15.5 % of attributable clicks).
